title: Find your Working with Children Check number
summary: Find your lost Working with Children Check (WWCC) number online.
intro:
If you've applied for a Working with Children Check (WWCC) and have lost your number, you can find it online.

The WWCC is an online system and does not have a physical card or certificate. The email you received when you were cleared has your WWCC number.

You can also access your WWCC on the Service NSW app.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to retrieve your WWCC number.

internal_links.text: access your WWCC on the Service NSW app

faqs.q: What is the Working with Children Check (WWCC)?
faqs.a: The WWCC is an online system and does not have a physical card or certificate.

faqs.q: How can I access my WWCC number?
faqs.a: You can find your number online, or access your WWCC on the Service NSW app.

faqs.q: What do I need to find my WWCC number?
faqs.a: You need either your driver licence number or your WWCC application number.
